title: The Survey as two stages in Harbour: read-only forecasts of a task and of its place, triggered by hand
description:
## Goal

Harbour can run a **Survey** of a ticket before its work starts: two short, read-only forecasts, each a fresh session standing at the current base commit and posting one comment on the ticket it surveys.

* **The task's view:** "why will this be difficult, and what, if anything, would you do first?"
* **The place's view:** where the task lands in the codebase, what the obvious way would add, move, tangle, leave without a home or leave in two places, who else would have to learn about it, and what would leave the place better at this task's cost.

For now a person (or a session orchestrating on their behalf) triggers each one by hand. They are never a routed next step.

## Context

Over 2–5 November these two prompts were run by hand, as custom dispatches with the text filled in by an operator session, on about twenty tickets across Harbour and simple-dispatcher. Acting on them, ticket by ticket, moved the place ledger from mostly worse to mostly better. The record is on branch `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`:

* `docs/plans/survey/notes-2026-11-05.md`: where it stands, and the loop;
* `docs/plans/survey/prompt.md`: the task's view ("Side arm: Survey open-0") and the other prompts in use;
* `docs/plans/survey/global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`: the place's view.

This is a middle step. The prompts move into Harbour, but triggering, scoping and judging stay with people. A fuller integration comes later, if this keeps working.

## This step

1. **Two stage templates, one per view, holding the two prompts as they are.** Harbour fills in what the operator filled by hand: the ticket as it reads now, the base commit (main's head at dispatch, named in the comment's heading) and where to post (the surveyed ticket itself, not a separate record). The wording has been tuned on real tickets and should move unchanged, apart from those fill-ins. Each template's own description should say when it is used, so that nothing routes to it on its own.
2. **The Survey's notebook moves onto main, as reference docs.** Copy, from branch `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`: `docs/plans/survey.md`, everything under `docs/plans/survey/`, `experiments/place-change/place-change.mjs`, and `docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-02-ticket-intent/handoff-place-concept.md` if main doesn't have it. Take only those paths: that branch also carries unrelated, unmerged code that must not land.

**Not this ticket:**

* the builder's after-questions and the step-back (they are follow-ups into existing sessions, and stay by hand for now);
* removing the research stage's Surface Assessment, or any other overlap (later, once the Survey runs on every ticket);
* triggering a Survey automatically.

## Done when

* Each template, dispatched by hand on one real ticket, gives a comment of the shape the hand-sent runs gave: read-only, at the named base, under its word limit, on the surveyed ticket.
* Routing is unchanged: show that the new stages are not offered as a next step on their own.
* The notebook files are on main, unchanged.

## Permission

You may add the two templates and whatever a new template needs to exist (its size ceiling, with the reason recorded, and anything that lists templates). You may copy the notebook files. No other behaviour changes.

## Report back

What you added, what had to learn about it, and anything about the prompts that didn't fit a template as they are.

## How to go about it (from a Survey before work began)

Two read-only Surveys of this ticket (posted on LIN-4150, 5 Nov 07:45, at `2eb73ae07`) agreed on where it binds. The person's scope call follows. Build it in this order. One PR is fine if each step is shown working before the next.

1. **Settle the fill-ins first, and write them down.** For each brace in the two prompts, say where its value comes from.
   * **The base commit:** nothing on the server knows main's head (`generatePrompt` is synchronous and makes no network calls), so the session resolves `origin/main` itself when it starts and names that commit in its heading. That's one wording change; record it.
   * `{RECORD}` folds into `{TICKET}`: the comment goes on the surveyed ticket.
   * The global prompt's hard-coded `LIN-4150` goes.
2. **Then the task view alone, as** `survey-task`**.** (The name `survey` is taken by `scripts/survey-*.mjs`, a separate programme.) Build it through `generatePrompt`, render it for a real ticket, and **diff it against a hand-sent prompt** (the shape is in `docs/plans/survey/prompt.md`, "Side arm: Survey open-0"). The diff shows what the stage frame adds and what has to be turned off:
   * its `GROUNDING_BY_KIND` entry is empty, as triage's is, because an unlisted kind gets every note, including "re-read at HEAD" and "implement the fix";
   * the rendered prompt must not tell the session to change code, open a PR or end with a PR link. If the frame or the dispatch preamble can't be kept from saying so without changing other stages, **stop and say so** on this ticket rather than work around it;
   * if the lead test forces a Goal/Process split, wrap the text minimally and record what was wrapped.
3. **Then the place view, as** `survey-place`**, the same way** (from `docs/plans/survey/global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`).
4. **Never offered on its own, made real in both places.** Leaving out `route` keeps a kind out of the selector, but the router's refusal (`parseRouteDecision`) and the task page's "Another step" list both read `EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_RECOMMENDATION`. Add both kinds there, as `retro` is. The proof is the byte-pinned `tests/fixtures/stage-router-prompts/` staying identical, plus a test that the router refuses each new kind.
5. **One copy of the text.** The templates are the source. When the notebook lands on main, `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` point at the templates for the live text and keep their history; they don't hold a second live copy. This prose lands once, with the last step.

**Not in this ticket** (the Surveys' "not this task's"): deriving "excluded" from a missing `route`; folding the per-kind tables into one template object; whether read-only forecasts belong in the stage registry at all.

## At merge (who else must learn about it)

* Every per-kind table knows both kinds:
  * the ones tests catch: `STAGE_LEADS`, `STAGE_INTENT`, `GROUNDING_BY_KIND`, `BUCKET_OF_KIND`, `COMPLETION_SIGNALS`, the source and rendered ceilings, and `FROZEN_TOTAL_BYTES`, with the reason recorded;
  * the ones nothing catches: `run-view.js` labels, the `workflow-config.js` enum, `llm-jobs.js`, and a row in `scripts/prompt-template-change-log.md`. Say for each whether it needed the kind, and why.
* The template counts in `docs/architecture/source-map.md`, `public/llms.txt`, `executive-summary.md` and `landing.md` are right. `executive-summary.md`'s "17 prompt templates with `route`" is already wrong (16 have one); make it say both numbers.
* Routing is unchanged: the stage-router fixtures are byte-identical, and the router refuses both new kinds.
* The notebook paths are on main, and nothing else from branch `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`.
* No new file without an obvious home.

## Implementation Plan

fits one session

plan-review due: yes

**Implemented as approved** (plan review: Approve), in PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2287](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2287>), merged to main as `29f14bf6`. The two Survey stages `survey-task` and `survey-place` are hand-triggered, read-only templates; routing excludes them; the dispatch preamble has a read-only variant for those two kinds only; the notebook paths were copied from `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`, with the two pointer docs edited. Deviations: none from the plan; review asked for three close-out fixes (an entry-path witness test, a notebook re-copy at merge time, pointer wording), made in the same PR. The plan's per-step detail (fill-ins table, frame, preamble, per-kind tables, routing, notebook, risks, landing order) is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail. The look-into/context/retro/triage preamble follow-up is LIN-4251.

comments.body:
Plan written into the description under `## Implementation Plan` (fits one session; plan-review due: yes).

Two things to know before the build starts:
- The dispatch preamble (`lib/proxy-preamble.js`) tells every worker to "open PRs" and to end with a "PR link". Step 2 swaps those two sentences for the two Survey kinds only, leaving every other kind byte-identical. If that cannot be done without touching another kind's output or loosening the `lin-3134` censuses, the plan says to stop and say so here, as the ticket asks.
- I ran two stub templates through `npm run test:unit` in a scratch worktree (32 of 23,242 tests failed). The failures are the table in Step 4. One surprise: `tests/fixtures/render-task-page-golden.json` changes, because the new kinds appear under "other prompts › more". That is the hand-trigger surface, and the diff should be those two keys only.

One reading of the ticket is fixed as the plan's own: "notebook files unchanged" has `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` as the exception, since step 5 edits them to point at the templates.

### Plan Review Verdict

**Verdict:** Approve. The premises hold at `origin/main` 2eb73ae0. Built as written, the plan delivers the two hand-triggered, read-only templates and the notebook, and leaves routing unchanged. Notes for the builder are below. None of them blocks.

**What I checked (main has not moved since the ticket was created at 07:41; HEAD is still 2eb73ae0):**
- **Notebook scope.** `git ls-tree` on `origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` lists exactly 14 files under the named paths. `handoff-place-concept.md` is missing on main, although its `_evidence` folder exists. `scripts/code-shape/seams.mjs` exists on main. The branch's other 21 changed files (getting-started, landing, routes, server.js and so on) are the unrelated code the ticket fences off, and the plan's pathspec checkout leaves them out.
- **Frame.** `finishStagePrompt` adds the following, in order: `withStageIntent`, the contract, grounding (`Object.hasOwn(GROUNDING_BY_KIND, kind)`, otherwise every note), attachments, then capabilities. Rendering `triage` and `retro` confirms it. `triage: []` is the right precedent. `recommend-stage-assembly.test.js:267` requires `## Goal\n<STAGE_LEADS[kind]>\n…## Process`, so the minimal wrap is forced and fits the prompts: the opening paragraph becomes the lead, and `## Process` goes before "**This is read-only.**". The read-only limit then sits under Process, which is where the test at `:281` wants limits to sit.
- **Routing.** `EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_RECOMMENDATION` (`prompt-templates.js:416`) has three readers: `action-kind.js` `rejectExcludedKind`, `task-page-loader.js:1022`, and the `getSelectableStages` filter at `:428`. The recommend override arm (`overrideArm`, `dispatch-entrance.js:1517`) does not read it. Excluding the kinds therefore does not block the hand path a driving session uses, and `retro` works the same way today. `DISPATCH_KINDS` derives from `PROMPT_TEMPLATES` keys, so `dispatchKindError` and the override accept the new kinds without further change.
- **Preamble.** It is attached through `attachProxyContext`, from `enqueueRow`'s `finalizePrompt`, after `createDispatchItem` has resolved `effectiveKind = kind || deriveDispatchKind(fields.promptName)` (`dispatch-factory.js:1026`). Gating the preamble by kind there is feasible without touching other kinds. The plan's stop rule covers the `lin-3134` censuses.
- **Counts.** There are 17 templates and 16 with `route`. `executive-summary.md:151`, `landing.md:18`, `source-map.md:168`, `llms.txt:247/272`, `proxy-instructions.js:849` and `audit.spec.js:226-227` all read as the plan says.

**Notes for the builder:**
1. **Cover the third entry path, and use one kind derivation.** The plan names two Survey entry paths: the session lane and the recommend kind-override arm. A third goes through `enqueueRow` and gets the preamble: the proxy `POST /dispatch` lane (`dispatch-entrance.js:1396`, where kind is `body.kind`, else derived from `promptName`). The hand-sent runs used that lane, and an orchestrating session may still use it with `kind: 'survey-task'`.
   - Implement the gate once, inside the shared `finalizePrompt`, so all three paths are covered.
   - Take the kind from the factory instead of recomputing it in `enqueueRow`. For example, have `createDispatchItem` call `finalizePrompt(resolvedHarness, effectiveKind)`. That gives one derivation, which is what the plan asks for.
   - Add the proxy lane to the "per entry path" witness ("neither 'open PRs' nor 'PR link'").
   - Leave the follow-up arm (`provisionResumeCredential` attach) alone. A follow-up into a Survey session is not a Survey kind.
2. **The brief line conflicts with the prompt.** The Survey text says "Don't look at anything after {BASE}: no later … tickets, comments", but the preamble line it keeps says the brief "folds in comments". Keeping the line matches the hand-sent runs, and that is a fair call for this ticket. Record the conflict in the PR's "anything that didn't fit" report rather than rewording either side.
3. **`content/landing.md:18`.** The line reads "17 deterministic templates, chosen by an LLM router". Changing only the number would make it more wrong, because retro and the two Survey kinds are never router-chosen. Reword it the way the plan rewords `executive-summary.md`: 19 templates, 16 of them chosen by the router.
4. **`lib/proxy-instructions.js:849`.** That line frames the kind override as "use sparingly and only on a clear engine miss". For `survey-task` and `survey-place` the override is the intended, and only, programmatic hand trigger. When adding the two keys, add a short clause saying these two are reached only this way, by hand, and are never recommended. Otherwise a driving session reading the catalog is told not to use the path it needs.
5. **Public `/templates` page.** It will publish both Survey texts, as `llms.txt:272` describes for every template. That is fine, since nothing in them is private. Check the rendered cards once the `LIN-4150` literal has been removed.
6. **Dead paths in the copied docs.** The notebook names paths that main lacks: `lib/founder-lookup.js`, `scripts/code-shape/areas.js`, `docs/session-lifecycle.md`, `docs/testing-and-ci.md` and `docs/papers/harbour/coherence-as-it-grows-census.js`. I found no unit scan over `docs/plans/` or `experiments/` that would reject them, so risk 3 probably does not fire. If one does, the plan's "allowance, not an edit" rule applies.
7. **Done-when 1 is post-merge.** The hand dispatch on a real ticket happens after merge. Put the four checks in the PR as a post-merge to-do: read-only, heading base equal to `origin/main` at dispatch, under 500 words, on the surveyed ticket.

Implementation PR is up: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2287 (branch feat/lin-4248-survey-stages, head 98eb3d72). CI green on that head: unit tests (23,282/23,282, also under test:hermetic), E2E shards 1-4, secret scan.

What landed: survey-task and survey-place, hand-triggered only (no route; excluded from recommendation, so the router refuses them and the Another-step list hides them). The notebook paths were copied from claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j by pathspec, and the two prompt docs now point at the templates.

Decisions to know about:
- The dispatch preamble now has a read-only variant for the two Survey kinds only (gated on the factory's resolved kind). Every other kind is byte-identical.
- User-visible copy change: the Another-step count on a task page now reads 3 steps left out, not 1, because the two Surveys count as excluded like retro does. The e2e expectation is updated to match.
- Follow-up still to file: look-into, context, retro and triage also get the open-PRs / PR-link lines in their preamble. Changing them is a behaviour change on other stages, so it is out of scope here.
- Post-merge check (Done-when 1), still to do: one hand dispatch of each kind on a real ticket, checking read-only, base named and equal to origin/main then, under 500 words, comment on the surveyed ticket.
Correction to my last comment: the follow-up for look-into, context, retro and triage is filed as LIN-4251, not still to file.

## Review — LIN-4248

PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2287, head `98eb3d72` (base `2eb73ae0`; main is now `a569b61c`, LIN-4249, docs-only, no file overlap with this PR, GitHub reports MERGEABLE).

CI: green on `98eb3d72`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all pass. I also ran `npm run test:unit` locally: 23,282/23,282 pass.

### What I checked
- **Plan vs. disk.** All 41 changed paths are the plan's: Steps 1–5 code, tests, docs and fixtures, plus the 14 notebook paths. Nothing else from `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` landed: the branch's other 21 files (getting-started, landing, routes, server.js and so on) are absent.
- **Wording.** Both rendered templates match the hand-sent text on the branch (`prompt.md` "Side arm: Survey open-0", `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`) word for word. The only differences are the fill-ins (`{RECORD}`/`LIN-4150` → the surveyed ticket), the `{BASE}` "Run `git fetch origin` and resolve `origin/main`" sentence, `## Goal`/`## Process`, and the existing READING Scope line. A rendered `survey-task` contains no Workflow, re-ground, implement or PR wording.
- **Routing.** `stage-router-prompts` fixtures are untouched. Both kinds are in `EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_RECOMMENDATION`. The router-refusal and `sessionSummaryOf().excluded` tests go red when that change is removed (I confirmed this myself). `render-task-page-golden.json` differs in exactly two inserts per case (the two keys in `morePromptKeys`/`promptMeta`), across all 7 cases.
- **Preamble.** Every non-Survey kind is byte-identical. The test compares the output with and without `kind` in both delivery modes, and goes red when the gate is disabled (11 tests fail).
- **Regression.** Recent history of `proxy-preamble.js`, `dispatch-entrance.js`, `dispatch-factory.js` and `prompt-templates.js` has no reverts and no fix to the same behaviour that this PR would undo.
- **Class.** The class is "the dispatch preamble invites PRs on a stage that must not make one". The siblings are `look-into`, `context`, `retro` and `triage`, which are **outside** this ticket. They are filed as LIN-4251. The browser's `+proxy` copy block (`public/common.js` `buildBlock`) has no PR wording, so it is not a sibling. The follow-up arms (`provisionResumeCredential`, collective, workspace-api-feedback) carry no Survey kind and were left alone as the plan said.

### Mutation checks (all reverted)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| Disable the preamble gate (`surveyKind = false`) | 11 fail ✓ |
| Factory calls `finalizePrompt(routing.harness)` without the kind | 1 fails ✓ |
| Remove the Surveys from `EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_RECOMMENDATION` | 2 fail ✓ |
| Remove the empty `GROUNDING_BY_KIND` entries | 3 fail ✓ |
| **Remove `kind: resolvedKind` from `enqueueRow`'s `attachProxyContext` call (`lib/dispatch-entrance.js:1083`)** | **All 23,282 unit tests stay green ✗** |

The last row is the production wire that connects the factory to the preamble. No test covers it. The plan asked for this witness under "Likeliest ways it breaks" 1 ("a test per entry path that the dispatched Survey text contains neither 'open PRs' nor 'PR link'"), and plan-review note 1 named the proxy lane too. The PR's claim that "the session lane, the recommend override and the proxy POST /dispatch lane all get it" is true: I checked it with a throwaway route-level test, which passes 7/7 on the real code and fails 6/7 with the wire removed. But nothing in the PR proves it. This is a missing test, not a design gap, so close-out can add it (fix 1).

### Fixes for close-out
1. **Add `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-dispatch-paths.test.js`.** Build the app and `call` helper the way `tests/unit/proxy-dispatch-bootstrap-token.test.js` does (express + `createProxyRoutes` with an `addItem` stub that captures the item, hermetic Linear transport). For each of `survey-task` and `survey-place`, assert that `captured.item.prompt` contains `## Workspace API access (auto-appended)` and matches none of `/open PRs|PR link|commit SHA/` on three paths:
   - (a) `POST /api/proxy/dispatch` with `{prompt, issueIdentifier, kind}`;
   - (b) the same with `promptName: kind` and no `kind`, which exercises the derived kind;
   - (c) `POST /api/proxy/recommend-and-dispatch` with `{issueIdentifier, kind}`.

   Add a control: `kind: 'implementation'` still matches. Confirm the file goes red with `kind: resolvedKind` removed from `lib/dispatch-entrance.js`, then restore it.
2. **Re-copy the notebook at merge time.** The branch moved after the copy: `420c5f1f` and `a3599475`, 08:27–08:28 UTC, versus the PR commit at 08:23. `log.md` (the 09:30 second blind pass), `notes-2026-11-05.md` (the "Superseded on one point" note) and `place-ledger.md` (the second blind-pass table) now differ from the branch. Done-when says "unchanged", and the note that is now missing changes how the results table reads. To fix:
   - re-run `git checkout origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j -- docs/plans/survey.md docs/plans/survey experiments/place-change docs/reviews/_evidence-2026-11-02-ticket-intent/handoff-place-concept.md`;
   - re-apply only the two pointer edits;
   - confirm `git diff origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j -- <those paths>` is empty except in `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`.
3. **Fix the pointer wording in `docs/plans/survey/global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`.** It says "Against the hand-sent text below", but the text below was removed. Change it to "Against the hand-sent text (in this file's git history and on branch `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`)".

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (Survey kinds' read-only dispatch, the plan's Step 2). Every dispatch entry path gives the Survey kinds the read-only preamble. No test exercises the `enqueueRow` → `attachProxyContext` `kind` wire (mutation above). **Before the merge:** fix 1 lands and goes red with `kind: resolvedKind` removed from `lib/dispatch-entrance.js`.
- **Inside** (the notebook copy, ticket step 2 / Done-when 3). The notebook files on main are the branch's current files, unchanged except the two pointer docs. **Before the merge:** fix 2. The condition is that `git diff origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j -- <14 paths>` shows only the two pointer files. If the branch moves again before merge, re-copy again.
- **Inside** (Done-when 1). Each template, dispatched by hand on one real ticket, gives a comment of the hand-sent shape. **After the deploy:** dispatch `survey-task` and then `survey-place` by hand on one real ticket (`recommend-and-dispatch` with `kind`). Check each comment: it is on the surveyed ticket; its heading's base equals `origin/main` at dispatch; it is under 500 words; the session changed nothing (no branch, PR or state change); and the session ended with the comment link, not a PR link. Record it as not run if it cannot run. It does not hold the close.
- **Rollback (named).** Revert the squash-merge commit of #2287. It is reversible: no migration and no persisted shape. Dispatch rows already queued with a Survey kind would then fail kind validation, so revert only with none queued.

Outside, not ledger items: LIN-4251 (other read-only kinds' PR lines), which is already filed. The brief line "folds in comments" against the Survey's "nothing after {BASE}" is recorded in the PR as accepted, as plan-review note 2 asked.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The templates, routing exclusion and preamble gate are correct and match the plan. Close-out must add the missing entry-path witness (fix 1), re-copy the notebook from where the branch now stands (fix 2) and fix the pointer wording (fix 3). The hand dispatch stays a post-deploy step.

## Close-out — LIN-4248

**Merged:** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2287, squash-merged to main as `29f14bf6`, pinned with `--match-head-commit 0fc3166d`. The deploy landed (production footer shows `29f14bf`; GitHub deployment `Harbour / production` for that sha = success). Post-merge `Tests` run on main: success.

**CI:** CI exists. On the exact merged head `0fc3166d` all seven checks passed: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success. Local `npm run test:unit` on that tree: 23,289/23,289.

### Changes I made after the Approve (review line → commit)
| Review fix | Commit | What |
|---|---|---|
| Fix 1: entry-path witness | `8c393f65` | New `tests/unit/lin-4248-survey-dispatch-paths.test.js`: for `survey-task` and `survey-place`, asserts the dispatched prompt has the access block and none of `open PRs / PR link / commit SHA` on (a) `POST /dispatch` with `kind`, (b) `POST /dispatch` with `promptName` only (derived kind), (c) `POST /recommend-and-dispatch`; plus a control that `implementation` still matches. Mutation: with `kind: resolvedKind` removed from `lib/dispatch-entrance.js` (`enqueueRow` → `attachProxyContext`), 6 of 7 fail (control passes); restored, 7/7 pass. |
| Fix 2: re-copy notebook | `0fc3166d` | `log.md`, `notes-2026-11-05.md`, `place-ledger.md` re-copied from `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` at `a3599475`. After the copy, `git diff origin/claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j` over the 14 paths shows only `prompt.md` and `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md`. Branch was re-checked unmoved (`a3599475`) immediately before the merge. |
| Fix 3: pointer wording | `0fc3166d` | `global-offshoot-prompt-v2-code.md` now says "Against the hand-sent text (in this file's git history and on branch `claude/cool-rubin-6acj5j`)". |

No stale citation or comment needed fixing beyond these.

### Ledger
- **Inside — read-only dispatch on every entry path:** settled by fix 1 and its mutation run (above).
- **Inside — notebook copy unchanged except the two pointer docs:** settled by fix 2 (diff above, re-checked at merge time).
- **Inside — Done-when 1 (hand dispatch on a real ticket): NOT RUN.** What: dispatch `survey-task` then `survey-place` by hand on one real ticket (`recommend-and-dispatch` with `kind`) and check each comment (on the surveyed ticket, heading base equals `origin/main` at dispatch, under 500 words, no branch/PR/state change, ends with the comment link). Why: it launches two billed agent sessions that post comments on a real ticket, and picking the ticket is the operator's call. Who: the operator. It does not hold the close. What I did verify on what landed: production `/templates` publishes both cards ("Hand-triggered only, never routed… changes nothing else") with no `LIN-4150` literal, and the live `instructions` catalog lists both kinds as reachable "only this way, by hand".
- **Rollback (named by review):** revert squash commit `29f14bf6`; reversible (no migration, no persisted shape). Revert only with no Survey-kind dispatch rows queued, since they would fail kind validation.
- **Outside:** LIN-4251 (look-into, context, retro, triage still get the open-PRs / PR-link lines). Already filed by the author; I linked it `related` to this ticket, set priority Medium (priorityLevel 2: wrong instruction on every run of four read-only stages, but nothing is lost today and the Survey gate shows the fix shape). Type label not set: the workspace API has no label write on an existing issue; noted on LIN-4251 (intended `kind:follow-up`, `front:prompt-engine`).
- **Accepted, recorded in the PR:** the preamble's "brief folds in comments" line against the Survey's "nothing after {BASE}" (plan-review note 2).

### Housekeeping
- Related tickets: none linked other than LIN-4251; no children. Nothing else to close.
- Description archived (snapshot verified: latest snapshot's description is identical to the pre-prune one, 22,039 chars) and pruned: the Implementation Plan body is replaced by a stub (headings `Implementation Plan`, `fits one session`, `plan-review due: yes` kept word for word). Problem statement, Done when, scope and the rest are untouched.

## Survey 1a (round 3)

**1. Why was it difficult?** It wasn't hard to reason about, but it was wide. The change bound in three places. First, the per-kind tables scattered across `lib/` (leads, intent, grounding, buckets, completion signals, run-view labels, LLM jobs) and the tests and docs that count templates. Second, the frozen byte budgets. Third, the dispatch preamble, which is a contract shared by every kind. The plan's stub-run list made the first two nearly mechanical. The preamble was the real seam: the kind had to travel from the factory into `finalizePrompt` without changing any other kind's bytes. I handed that step to a subagent, so my view of it is secondhand; it landed without loosening the `lin-3134` censuses. What surprised me came after push: two E2E specs (the templates page count, and "Another step" now saying 3 steps left out, not 1). The stub run was unit-only, so it couldn't see them.

**2. What would I have done first?** Grepped `tests/e2e` for the counts and run the affected specs before pushing. CI caught both, but a local run would have found them in about 20 seconds.

**3. What would I tidy?**
- `SURVEY_KINDS` in `lib/proxy-preamble.js` is a second list of the same two kinds that `EXCLUDED_FROM_AI_RECOMMENDATION` names. I'd rather the template def carried the fact (`readOnly: true`) and both places read it.
- The left-out line now tells the user the Surveys "do not fit this task's state". That isn't why they're hidden; they're hand-only. Retro had the same inaccuracy, but now it's three of them.

**4. If the area were how I'd want it**, each template would be one object carrying its own per-kind facts: bucket, label, signal, grounding, intent, job group and preamble mode. The ticket would then have been "add two template objects and copy the notebook", touching one file plus the text.

**5. What did the ticket or plan get wrong?** Little. The plan was accurate where it had looked, and the fill-in table and the forced Goal/Process wrap were exactly right. It missed the E2E layer, and it didn't foresee that excluding a kind changes visible copy on every task page. The ticket's "notebook unchanged" pulled against "point the docs at the templates"; the plan resolved that, but the ticket should have stated the exception itself.

**6. What did it leave behind?**
- A first kind-specific preamble branch, which sets a precedent (LIN-4251 covers the other read-only stages).
- `finalizePrompt` now takes the kind as a second argument; every other caller ignores it.
- The read-only rule is now stated twice, in the template body and in the preamble.
- `lib/proxy-instructions.js`'s hand-typed kind list is still incomplete: I added only these two.
- What got simpler: the notebook now holds no live copy of the prompts.

**7. Did the larger scope pay?** Mostly yes. The preamble had to be in this ticket, or "read-only" would have been false in the text actually dispatched. One PR kept the reasoning in one place. The cost was mostly volume: 39 files and about 3,800 lines, most of them notebook copy, which is noise for a reviewer. I'd draw the line at moving the notebook copy into its own trivial docs PR and keeping everything else together.

issue.title: Preamble: look-into, context, retro and triage still tell the worker to open PRs
